title: Bubbling Font
author: Joni type
description:
Bubbling is a bold and cheerful bubble display font designed to bring fun, energy, and personality into every design. Featuring chunky rounded letterforms, playful curves, and eye-catching proportions, this typeface perfectly captures the spirit of pop art, retro cartoons, and candy-inspired aesthetics. Complete with uppercase, lowercase, numerals, punctuation, multilingual support, and unique alternates, Bubbling is the perfect choice for designers who want to create memorable and joyful visual experiences.
